architect.hypothesis: Routing decisions that prioritize minimizing total energy consumption over minimizing travel distance will improve delivery efficiency for electric vehicles in mixed traffic conditions
architect.prediction: Reducing incremental energy cost while maintaining reasonable travel distances will result in better overall route optimization for EV fleets
